$comment: Single source of truth for the Badge API. Every framework package is tested against this file.
name: badge
title: Badge
description: A small label for a status, a count or a category.
thumb: ActiveNewDraft

dot.html: as the first child

examples.title: Variants
examples.description: Neutral for plain labels, primary to draw the eye, and the status colours for success, warning and danger.

examples.title: With a status dot
examples.description: Add a dot for live status. The dot follows the badge's text colour.

examples.title: In context
examples.description: Badges sit inside buttons and next to headings without extra CSS.

a11y: Badges are plain text, so screen readers read them as they are.
Never rely on colour alone: the label says the status ("Failed", not just a red badge).
The status dot is decorative and hidden from screen readers.
Text meets 4.5:1 contrast in every style and mode.
